4279-4314-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1115-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6112--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

5972-5973-6495.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
5972-5973-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
5972-5973-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

339-677-4068-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-677-4068-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5241-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5241-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5241-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

301-713-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1563-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

457-1458-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-7340.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature tapped in step 5.
Repeat from step 2
457-1458-7340.notes:
If you control an artifact creature, you can untap that creature with the additional Sewer-veillance Cam trigger. It can then be tapped by Urza for blue mana, which can then be used for Urza's other ability.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3899-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2638-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2638-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-2292-6972--112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
1483-2292-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1887-3334-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Vorinclex and Lae'zel, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2275-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1099-4740-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {3}{B} if Sling-Gang Lieutenant is in your hand
1099-4740-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 5 if Sling-Gang Lieutenant is on top of your library.
1099-4740-5220-6900.description:
Cast Sling-Gang Lieutenant either from the top of your library by paying 4 life or from your hand by paying {3}{B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant three times by sacrificing the Goblin tokens and then Sling-Gang Lieutenant.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Sling-Gang Lieutenant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing target opponent to lose 3 life and you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

681-4826-5413-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4826-5413-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2173-5220-6535.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

38-2173-5220-6634.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

81-292-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
81-292-1495.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2468-5775-6587-6588.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
2468-5775-6587-6588.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune by tapping Ultimecia, Omnipotent, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. Fortune triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

3490-3641-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-3641-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Distinguished Conjurer indestructible.
3490-3641-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1385-2530-2946-4050.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1385-2530-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

997-2523-2869.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-2523-2869.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

238-2034-2533.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
238-2034-2533.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {C}{C}.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2644-4050-4763.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand.
2644-4050-4763.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to the creature.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Koll triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1369-3812-3814.notablePrerequisites: Two lands that tap for blue.
1369-3812-3814.description:
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Simic Ragworm.
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Argothian Elder.
Tap Quicksilver Elemental for at least {C}{U}.
Pay {U} to untap Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat.
